population: CHNS 2009 released-data analytical population: adults aged 35-74 years inclusive, linked person/wave records with documented male/female category and available age, BMI from released height/weight, central-serum glucose and whole-blood HbA1c under the frozen common-complete-case release policy. No diabetes, treatment or pregnancy exclusion is claimed. Age/sex composition is not supplied. This is a selected analytical sample, not a nationally representative population; no participant input.

measurement.description: No numeric unit or specimen conversion is performed. Target glucose mmol/L and HbA1c% are used directly. Source/target specimen, assay, population, timing and preprocessing differences remain explicitly assumed applicability gaps; identity mode is arithmetic only.

checks.reason: Proposed named-correlation target-task proxy under explicit interpretation and applicability assumptions. Original analytic weighting remains not_reported, so strict v1 must return unavailable/null. Contextual source coefficients and marginals are not numeric feedback.
